title: Similarweb Search Engine & AI Referral Market Share 2024
author: David Carr
content:
# Market Share Overview

Global search engine dynamics reflect steady Google dominance alongside rapid growth in alternative conversational engines.

> "Traditional organic search clicks remain the primary revenue driver for commercial web publishing, accounting for over 64% of trackable sessions."

## Search Engine Traffic Distribution

| Platform | Global Market Share | Referral Growth YoY |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Google | 89.2% | -2.1% |
| Microsoft Bing | 3.4% | +14.2% |
| Perplexity AI | 0.4% | +480.0% |
| DuckDuckGo | 1.8% | +3.1% |

## Analysis of Generative Referrals

Generative AI referrals represent 1.2% of total external referral traffic to digital publishers, demonstrating that conversational search complements rather than eliminates organic destination visits.
